thread:
nina: FYI: we're targeting GA for On-Prem Agent v2.1 on 2026-04-02. Key delivery items: per-tenant compliance bundles (signed), KMS auto-rotate flag (opt-in), improved offline installer for air-gapped customers, and a short telemetry opt-out flow. No app-level downtime expected; agent process will restart.

nina: Customer-facing checklist to paste into rollout emails:
- Validate KMS IAM policy and test decrypt on staging
- Run `./agent healthcheck --mode full`
- If using pinned model artifacts, schedule a 30m window for cache warmup
- For air-gapped installs, fetch `offline-bundle-v2.1.tar.gz` from the partner bucket

raj: Quick Q: are the compliance bundles generated automatically per tenant or do we sign them on-demand?

michael: They are generated per-deployment during install/upgrade. Output: `evidence/attest.tar.gz` (contains attest.json + control-mapping.csv + signed_manifest.txt). We also push checksums to the tenant S3 prefix: `s3://tenants/<tenant-id>/onprem/v2.1/attest/`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: pipeline queued: onprem-agent/v2.1 -> canary (10 hosts) -> regional rollout. Canary scheduled: 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z. CI link: https://ci.internal/release/801

legal: Heads-up: legal wants the signed_manifest to include the build id and the signing key id. We also need a short template for customers requesting evidence for audits.

infra: Noted. Signing key id is included. We'll add a one-click evidence export in the tenant console for the next patch.

raj: KMS rotation — default behavior? auto or manual? Also what happens for HSM-backed keys?

michael: Default: `--auto-rotate-kms=false`. We provide `--auto-rotate-kms` for those who opt in. For HSM-backed keys we run a staged rollover: agent keeps old key active for 2 mins overlap, verifies signed tokens, then retires old key. We'll include a dry-run mode: `--kms-rotate --dry-run`.

nina: Migration story: no database schema changes. We added `config-upgrade` helper: `./agent config-upgrade --from 2.0 --to 2.1`. It's safe to run multiple times. Please don't run on production without a backup of `/var/lib/agent/config`.

ops-bot: note: pilot maintenance window (read-only): 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T10:30:00Z. Customers in pilot will be notified by CS.

michael: Telemetry defaults for the installer: metrics retained 14 days, debug logs retained 3 days. Telemetry export is disabled for air-gapped installs. For hosted telemetry opt-out we added a `--telemetry=local-only` flag and a GUI toggle in the tenant console.

nina: SEs: please review your pilot customers. If anyone needs a freeze or custom rotation cadence, open a ticket in #support and tag me. We'll hold the rollout for any commercial or compliance blockers.

cto_jen: Nice. Compliance and CS coordinate on the audit template and the first 3 pilots. If any red flags, pause the release.

legal: we'll draft the audit request template and share by EOD Tue.

nina: Will post final release notes + download links by EOD Mon. Thanks all :rocket:
